Seasons

Set the months each crawl, trail, road trip or event actually runs. In season, it gets an "In season" badge and shows in the highlights (Top trails, the Trails menu, the home page). Off-season, it stays listed with "back in [month]" and moves to the end of lists. Members and organizers can suggest months; nothing changes until you confirm here.
